جَارِزٌ , applied [to land, and hence,] to (tropical:) a woman, Barren: (S, A, K:) the woman is likened to land that produces no herbage. (TA.) [See also جُرُزٌ.] ―
-b2- أَرْضٌ جَارِزَةٌ Dry and rugged land encompassed by sands or by a [level tract such as is called] قَاع: (S, K:) pl. جَوَارِزُ: (S, TA:) mostly applied to islands of the sea. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
